fact: The Moroccan digital ministry (MTNRA) and Mistral announced a language-identification classifier for Arabic dialects including Darija and a Voxtral Darija speech-recognition model, saying they will soon be open source and that further models are in development.

Tech Review Africa reports the Ministry of Digital Transition and Mistral AI released in open source a language identification classifier for Arabic dialects including Darija and the Voxtral speech recognition model for Darija, under the AI Made in Morocco roadmap.

fact: Morocco's digital transition ministry says JAZARI ROOT, whose constitutive convention was approved in August 2026, is to cover data centres, advanced computing, data platforms and sovereign national AI capability.
The ministry is developing a sovereign large language model for Darija and Amazigh, and plans a national Data Factory platform to prepare data for AI models (presented 2026-09-08).
LesEco says Morocco is developing a sovereign large language model for darija and amazigh, with JAZARI ROOT focused on sovereign language technologies.
LesEco says the Sovereign Meeting Assistant, a solution developed in Morocco, is trained on Moroccan GPUs and hosted on the sovereign marketplace.
LesEco says the Sovereign Meeting Assistant was trained on Moroccan GPUs.
Aujourd'hui le Maroc reports that an AI Factory at Nouaceur (Nexus) is to be a 16 MW first phase of a programme reaching 36 MW by end 2027, with an announced investment of 12 billion dirhams.

TelQuel reports that Nexus AI Factory has been launched in Nouaceur with a budget of 12 billion dirhams and that the Igoudar Digital Complex is under development in Dakhla with backing from the CDG and the Mohammed VI Investment Fund, Nexus targeting 36 MW by end-2027.
